decision.shared_anchor_result: Prioritizes likely edited text in this fresh panel. Genuine human revisions also rank first.

prompts.smol2:
Say the same thing in a different way. Return only one complete sentence, without quotation marks, labels or commentary. Use between {minimum} and {maximum} words. Preserve the facts and technical terms.

{target}

protocol.evaluation_policy: Previous NIST, USGS, and Global Voices confirmations are development-only sanity cases for this comparison. The same protocol and arithmetic are applied to the fresh panel with no fitting, threshold tuning, or method selection. Show changes relative to both existing matched marks and the one-location cap. Shared model weights make the two rankings correlated. Customer confidence and production logic remain outside this experiment.
protocol.generation_policy: Two previously pinned Apache-2.0 local generator families make one offline attempt each per group. Apply the earlier EOS, source-copy, sentence, word-length, exact source alignment and prior-overlap rules. Retain only one exact replacement with both interior foci in the serving scope. Track unavailable attempts separately.

methods.agreement_rank: Rank a sentence first only when the two methods have the same unique top. An exact tie or disagreement leaves it unranked.
methods.matched: Existing frozen matched full-window marks on the two native focuses. Unchanged fit, operating point and directions.
methods.matched_agreement: Keep the existing matched top-one location only when the shared-anchor rank agrees. No new cutoff.
methods.matched_top_one: Keep only the unique native winner when it is already marked by the matched method. This comparator isolates the one-location cap.
methods.native_rank: Compare the existing native left-three and right-three context responses, each associated with its middle sentence.
methods.shared_rank: Score the first and fourth sentence with each interior focus independently between them. Compare two raw responses using the same outer sentences in the same order.

protocol.metrics: For ranking, exact first-position hits, disagreements, ties, and admitted file totals. For matched mark variants, useful rewrite localization is at least 0.30 non-whitespace intersection over union with the known edit, flagged human originals and genuine revisions, edited human locations selected, and paired retained/lost flags by source. No ranking-only human result is an AI flag. Report development and fresh results separately.
protocol.scope: English plain TXT, one paragraph, exactly four sentences, 68–134 whitespace words, both interior sentences with at least 12 model segmentation words. Controls join only adjacent direct HTML paragraphs, if needed, with one space. Require complete native token coverage; no clipping or rescaling of scores.
protocol.source_policy: Seasoned Advice public Q&A with original posts and both named public revision records dated May 2018 through December 2021, all carrying CC BY-SA 4.0; one original owner and thread per group. Require same-source body pairs with one exact changed interior sentence in a four-sentence excerpt and three unmodified neighboring sentences. Exclude personal health, bereavement, known external prose, quotations, images and markup from scored excerpts. Choose only from text geometry, distinct sources and edit variety before generation. The normalized exact 12-token exposure check excludes prior or cross-group overlap.
